edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Stacked Transfusion sustain lets you farm back and stabilise — his Rake poke no longer outpaces your healing.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: His 6 outpaces yours: Shadow Assault burst plus roam tempo beat a pre-item Hemoplague — pool buys one escape.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Serrated Dirk plus ult resets restore his one-combo threat — your first item stabilises, it does not win yet.

edits.before: Late Vlad is a raid boss: pool their engage, R their clump, and drain whatever stayed to argue.
edits.after: Rylai's and Zhonya's blank his one-combo — pool the blades, R the clump, and outscale him hard from here.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: Rake is 9s at rank 1 and the return blades are most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Shadow Assault is 100s: while it is down his 6-to-9 kill pressure halves. Your pool is 28s — it answers his full combo, never poke you can heal back.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: Rake is his only poke and costs 50 mana — heal each return-blade hit back with a free Q and his chip goes nowhere.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Past river with W down, Assassin's Path vaults any wall to cut your retreat and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall.

edits.before: At 6 your Hemoplague plus Sanguine Pool all-in and gank-dodge beats his level-6 dive.
edits.after: At 6 his Shadow Assault burst and roam tempo outpace your pre-item Hemoplague.
